crusadecraft.civ.info.on: Autonomous civilisations: on. %s construction(s) placed by the computer on its own. /crusade civ annuler undoes them.
crusadecraft.civ.info.off: Autonomous civilisations: off (civilisations section of the settings). %s construction(s) placed by the computer on its own.
crusadecraft.civ.undone: %s computer construction(s) undone: their blocks gradually return to what they were.
crusadecraft.codex.civ.p0: If you turn it on (the $(l)civilisations$() section of the settings, off at first), the computer's realms build on their own: a tower, a camp, an outpost, then a fort for duchies and above, on their own lands, near their cities.
crusadecraft.codex.civ.p1: They only build in loaded chunks, never in a colony, only on flat natural ground, and within the allowed zone. Every replaced block is noted: $(l)/crusade civ annuler$() undoes everything. Back up your world before turning it on.
